description:
Grow your cloud engineering career at Oracle while helping U.S. federal customers move from technical questions to working solutions. Join our Federal Civilian Solution Engineering team as a forward deployed Cloud Solution Engineer supporting a portfolio of smaller accounts  and focused, transactional opportunities. Our Federal Civilian team serves U.S. civilian government agencies, U.S.-based international governmental organizations, Tribal Nations, and Alaska Native Corporations. 
  
 This hybrid position involves regular in-office and/or customer-site work. Candidates must be based in the greater Washington, DC area. Travel up to 30% as needed. 
  
  
 What Makes This Opportunity Unique 
 Gain broad customer exposure while taking responsibility for defined technical engagements. You will help customers deploy and migrate workloads, identify additional cloud use cases, and apply repeatable solutions with support from senior engineers. We value federal experience across departments and agencies; prior work with a particular agency is not required. 
  
  

 What You Will Do 
 Manage defined technical activities across a portfolio of smaller accounts; organize priorities, document next steps, and keep customers and account teams informed. 
 Conduct focused discovery sessions to understand mission needs, workload requirements, existing environments, security considerations, and practical adoption barriers. 
 Configure and demonstrate OCI services across compute, storage, networking, identity, and databases using established architecture patterns and guidance from senior engineers. 
 Support landing zone deployment and workload migrations through configuration, dependency checks, testing, documentation, and coordination with Cloud Adoption Engineers and implementation partners. 
 Deliver scoped demonstrations and proofs of concept with clear success criteria; document results and help customers evaluate technical fit. 
 Identify additional workload opportunities during customer engagements; record requirements, assess initial feasibility, and engage account teams and specialists for deeper qualification. 
 Create solution diagrams, preliminary estimates, implementation notes, and customer handoffs; apply security guidance and involve specialists for complex architecture or authorization questions. 
 Troubleshoot routine deployment issues, escalate blockers with useful evidence, and track customer progress from discovery through deployment and effective use of OCI services. 
  
  
 What Makes You a Great Fit 
 Three or more years of relevant experience in cloud engineering, systems engineering, solution engineering, technical consulting, software engineering, or a related technical role preferred. 
 Experience supporting U.S. federal government customers, with an understanding of mission needs, stakeholder coordination, and secure technology delivery. Experience from any federal department or agency is valued. 
 PRACTICAL EXPERIENCE WITH AT LEAST ONE CLOUD PLATFORM: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud (GCP). 
 Working knowledge of compute, storage, networking, operating systems, identity, and database fundamentals, with the ability to configure and troubleshoot scoped solutions. 
 Experience contributing to deployments, migrations, demonstrations, or proofs of concept; ability to follow established patterns and recognize when specialist support is needed. 
 Foundational understanding of federal cloud security and governance, including awareness of FedRAMP and the ATO process, with a willingness to deepen that knowledge. 
 Clear communication, practical problem-solving skills, and the ability to manage concurrent customer activities. Exposure to Terraform, Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Git is preferred. 
 U.S. citizenship is required for federal customer engagement. Relevant cloud certifications are preferred; OCI experience and an interest in workload discovery are advantages. 
  
  
 Grow Your Career at Oracle 
 At Oracle, develop technical depth through hands-on engagements, mentorship from experienced cloud engineers, and collaboration with adoption specialists. Build OCI expertise, pursue relevant certifications, and strengthen the consulting and architecture skills that support progression into more senior engineering roles. 
  
  
 Your Impact 
 You will make cloud expertise accessible to customers with focused requirements and help them achieve successful deployments. Your follow-through and workload discovery will support mission outcomes and create a foundation for continued OCI adoption. 
  
  
 Come Join Us 
 Bring your federal experience, curiosity, and commitment to delivery to Oracle. Build your technical range and take the next step in your cloud engineering career. 
 #LI-PA4 
  
  

Disclaimer:

 Certain U.S. based or U.S. customer or client-facing roles may be required to comply with applicable requirements, such as immunization/occupational health mandates, and/or drug testing requirements. 

 Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations only 

US: Hiring Range in USD from: $118,700 to $194,400 per annum. May be eligible for equity. Eligible for commission with an estimated pay mix of 70/30.


Oracle maintains broad salary ranges for its roles in order to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect Oracle's differing products, industries and lines of business.
Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity.

Oracle US offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes the following:
1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including expert medical opinion
2. Short term disability and long term disability
3. Life insurance and AD&D
4. Supplemental life insurance (Employee/Spouse/Child)
5. Health care and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts
6. Pre-tax commuter and parking benefits
7. 401(k) Savings and Investment Plan with company match
8. Paid time off: Flexible Vacation is provided to all eligible employees assigned to a salaried (non-overtime eligible) position. Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.
9. 11 paid holidays
10. Paid sick leave: 72 hours of paid sick leave upon date of hire. Refreshes each calendar year. Unused balance will carry over each year up to a maximum cap of 112 hours.
11. Paid parental leave
12. Adoption assistance
13. Employee Stock Purchase Plan
14. Financial planning and group legal
15. Voluntary benefits including auto, homeowner and pet insurance

The role will generally accept applications for at least three calendar days from the posting date or as long as the job remains posted.
As part of Oracle's onboarding process and consistent with applicable law, US-based employees are required to complete identity verification, which involves the collection and processing of their biometric information. Accommodations to this requirement may be granted following an individualized assessment.

 Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

 True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That’s why we’re committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

 We’re committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

 Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.
